2. Then deposit the converted amount? Wait, they want to deposit 10 dollars into their local bank account. But after conversion, they'd have some amount in EUR. And also deposit 10 dollars into their local bank account. So we should first convert 10 USD to EUR, get the result, then deposit 10 USD into account 987654.

We need to use the function calls. We'll call currency_conversion first. Then deposit. The deposit function expects account_id and amount. For deposit, we deposit 10 USD. But deposit function doesn't specify currency; presumably it uses default or same as account's base currency? The deposit function just takes amount. It might assume it's in the account's currency.
